title: Talk 2

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I often think of the fighters, the friends who have left us. Sometimes, I get lost in the idea that even now, I'm still fleeing... Doctor, have you been to Kazdel? That place... was the start of my journey, and once, I thought it would be my... end.

title: Talk after Promotion 2

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I became a Rhodes Island Operator to see my people treated well, to see them live on, and to give my fighters' deaths... real meaning. But... since coming to Rhodes Island, I've seen clearly what I, myself, am truly fighting for. That was a first for me.
